plateau_criterion: Longest contiguous run of the tau_TR grid (step 0.005, 0.05-0.999) with zero label changes vs. the previous grid point AND accuracy at its run maximum, evaluated over {72 geometry-backed library molecules' real normal-mode T/R references [ground truth: always clean, exact completeness] + benzene's 36 EMIT modes [no independent ground truth; label-change signal only]}.
